svg.title: One connection, four different signals
svg.desc: A carries frequent small heartbeats for reachability; B carries event-driven notification metadata; C carries event-driven images and live media; D carries lower-frequency CPU, network and log vitals. A heartbeat establishes reachability; images provide the observation to review. Start the review clock after loading or add its delay.

g.aria-label: Start the clock after media loads,
